case_name: Smt M Lakshmi Prasanna Kumara, ... vs Sri M Vijay Kumar Raju, E.Godavari Dist

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt M Lakshmi Prasanna Kumara, wife
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri M Vijay Kumar Raju, husband

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Wife seeks transfer of original petitions pending in different courts to Srikakulam court for hearing together.

legal_principles.principle: Access to justice is a fundamental right under Article 21 of the Constitution.
legal_principles.held: A person's access to justice is a guaranteed fundamental right under the Constitution and particularly Article 21. Denial of the right undermines public confidence in the justice delivery system and incentivises people to look for short cuts and other fora where they feel that injustice will be done quicker.
cited_cases: United Nations Development Programme, Access to Justice-Practice Note (2004)
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — because it is a fundamental right

legal_principles.principle: The right to expeditious and fair trial is guaranteed under Article 21 of the Constitution.
legal_principles.held: Article 21 of the Constitution takes in its sweep the right to expeditious and fair trial. Even Article 39A of the Constitution recognises the right of citizens to equal justice and free legal aid.
cited_cases: Brij Mohan Lal v. Union of India and Ors, (2012) 6 SCC 502
legal_principles.significance: HIGH — because it is a fundamental right

legal_principles.principle: Access to justice includes qualitative access to justice, not just improving individual's access to courts.
legal_principles.held: Access to justice is, therefore, much more than improving an individual's access to courts, or guaranteeing representation. It must be defined in terms of ensuring that legal and judicial outcomes are just and inequitable.
cited_cases: United Nations Development Programme, Access to Justice-Practice Note (2004)
legal_principles.significance: MEDIUM — because it highlights the importance of fairness in justice delivery

outcome.final_order: All Transfer Civil Miscellaneous Petitions are dismissed.
